content:
maya: Heads-up: bringing up halcyon-14b (decoder-only, 14B) for intake. Need quant sanity checks, perf benchmarks, and release coordination. Sharing an initial checklist below — please add or claim items.

liam: Assigning owners: quant experiments (liam), perf bench (sasha), evals (samir), docs + catalog (eva).

sasha: Quick note: I'll run perf across p3/p4 and do continuous-batching sims. Command I'll use for the full run:
```
python infra/bench/runner.py --model halcyon-14b --batch-sizes 1,8,32 --seq-len 512 --mode quant --quant 4 --warmup 50 --iter 200
```
Expect results in ~6h.

maya: Minimal intake checklist (working):
- model card draft (owner: eva)
- catalog entry + metadata (eva)
- 4-bit & 8-bit quant runs + calibration (liam)
- GPTQ & AWQ parity checks (liam)
- accuracy/regression suite (nli/qa/summarization/longform) (samir)
- human eval sample (200 prompts) (samir)
- latency & throughput perf (p3/p4/aurora) (sasha)
- KV-cache correctness & long-context tests (liam)
- fallback variant (fp16) + routing policy (maya/liam)
- docs PR + changelog + announcement draft (eva)
- canary scheduling + rollback plan (deploy-bot / eng-sre)

samir: On evals: reusing existing harness, adding targeted safety set and longform coherence tests. Will run HF eval harness + our manual sample. ETA for initial pass ~4h.

liam: For quant tooling: planning to run both GPTQ and AWQ, and produce artifacts for model-store. Also will validate KV-cache across 1k-step recurrency and multi-token streaming.

maya: Yes, run both. Important: quantify generation quality delta (BLEU/ROUGE + length-conditioned failure rate) and report any systematic tokenization mismatches.

sasha: Ran a quick smoke on p4d with AWQ-4bit: latency ~45ms @batch1 for 512 tokens. Raw log snippet:
```
[2025-06-01 09:12:34] model=halcyon-14b quant=4 latency=45.2ms tokens/sec=220
[2025-06-01 09:12:50] batch=8 latency=120.4ms tokens/sec=480
```
Uploading the full CSV to /artifacts/halcyon/perf.

samir: Early evals: GPTQ-4bit shows a 1.1% drop on longform coherence vs fp16, AWQ-4bit ~0.4% drop. Human eval in progress. Will post diff heatmaps.

eva: Drafted initial catalog PR: <https://redwood.internal/pulls/halcyon-catalog>. Metadata fields added: 'recommended_quant': 'awq-4bit', 'fallback': 'fp16', 'slo_latency_ms': '50@batch1'. I'll add sample performance table once sasha uploads final numbers.

maya: Release coordination notes: announce in #eng-release 24h before canary; schedule canary to run on Dedicated with small traffic and auto-fallback. @deploy-bot can you create the canary job?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary task created: canary-halcyon-1766809123. Ticket INF-4821. Link: <https://deploy.redwood/canary/1766809123>.

liam: I'll push quant artifacts to model-store under halcyon-14b/quant/v1 and add a README with reproduction steps and calibration commands.

sasha: Reminder: include perf numbers for both p3 and p4 in the docs and a memory footprint table. Also note the peak GPU mem for batch sizes.

maya: Who will draft the external announcement copy? Need short blurb + migration guidance for customers who pin model versions.

eva: I can draft announcement and a docs section: short blurb + migration steps. Suggested guidance: 'pin to fp16 if you require strict parity; for cost-sensitive workloads recommend awq-4bit with monitoring.'

samir: Human eval ETA now ~8h. If human eval shows >2% degradation on any core metric, we flag and hold the canary.

liam: Ops note: add routing policy to prefer awq-4bit for Hosted with a trial rate limit and auto-fallback to fp16 on quality alarms. Will attach JSON policy in the routing repo.

maya: Final pre-canary checklist status:
- [x] catalog PR open
- [x] perf smoke completed
- [x] evaluation baseline run completed
- [ ] full quant artifacts uploaded (liam)
- [ ] docs PR & announcement draft (eva)
- [ ] canary job scheduled (deploy-bot)
- [ ] rollback plan documented (eng-sre)
Please update inline as you complete items.

sasha: Full perf CSV uploaded -> /artifacts/halcyon/perf/full_results.csv. Includes batch1/batch8/batch32 and memory columns.

eva: Docs PR: <https://redwood.internal/pulls/halcyon-docs> added SLO table, recommended configs, and sample code snippet for client usage.

samir: Human eval done: AWQ within 0.6% of fp16 on our human sample. Detailed diffs posted to /artifacts/halcyon/evals/diffs.csv.

maya: OK moving forward with canary at 2025-06-02 16:00 UTC. I'll post announcement draft in #announcements by 12:00 UTC for final review.

liam: I'll also write a short internal runbook covering rollback commands, model-store artifact locations, and routing toggles.

sasha: :rocket: good luck everyone.
